newsitem.title: UK: Document leak will not affect UK Budget - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Document leak will not affect UK Budget - Treasury.

text.p: The British Treasury said on Monday that the leak of documents to a national newspaper will not affect Tuesday's budget.

The Daily Mirror said it had been passed top secret papers revealing tax changes in the budget. The paper, realising that premature disclosure of the 36 documents could cause chaos on international stock markets, decided to return them to the government, its editor Piers Morgan said.
But a Treasury spokesman, asked to comment on the reported leaks, said: "This will not change the content of the budget."
